title: A PLACE FOR THOSE WHO SERVE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the Lord said to Moses, "Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns. Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for their cattle, flocks and all their other livestock." - Num 35:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As the land was being divided, God made special provision for the Levites. Unlike the other tribes, the Levites received no large territory of their own, because their inheritance was the Lord Himself and the work of serving Him. Yet God did not leave them without a home. He commanded that towns and pasturelands be given to them, scattered throughout the other tribes' territories, so they would have places to live and provision for their needs.

There is tender care in this arrangement. The Levites had given themselves to God's service, and God made sure they were provided for through the generosity of the whole nation. They did not need to grasp for land or worry about their livelihood; God had built provision into the very structure of the nation's life.

This reflects a beautiful truth about God's care for those who serve Him. When we give ourselves to the Lord's work, we may seem to give up certain securities that others enjoy. But God does not overlook His servants. He provides, often through the kindness of His people, exactly what is needed.

Jesus assured His followers that if they seek first God's kingdom, everything they need will be provided (Matt 6:33). We are not called to serve God anxiously, wondering how our needs will be met. The God who arranged homes for the Levites is the same God who cares for you. Whatever you have surrendered for His sake, He sees it, and He will provide for you in His faithful way.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you trust God to provide for you as you serve Him?
2. Have you ever hesitated to give yourself to God's work out of fear for your needs?
3. How can you help provide for those who serve God's people around you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful Provider, thank You that You care for those who give themselves to Your service. Help me to serve You without anxiety, trusting that You will provide, and to be generous toward Your servants. Amen.
